location.exact_quote: 訳: その契約の下で、会社はその債務について主たる当事者として責任を負い、保証人は二次的にのみ責任を負う。

findings.rationale: 英文の remains liable は会社が引き続き責任を負うという状態の継続を明示しているが、訳文の『責任を負い』は単なる現在の責任関係だけを示し、その継続相を落としている。主たる責任と二次的責任の方向自体は保存されている。入力内の別の remains の例（line 100–101）では『依然として』により継続が保存されており、同じ脱落は認められない。
findings.suggested_direction: 会社について『その債務について主たる当事者として引き続き責任を負い』とし、remains の継続を保存する。

adjudications.rationale: 段階1の重要度・程度を維持する。主要・最重要と二次的という高低は語義自体から導出でき、違い行もこの対立を説明している。類義語からの軸転移や対立の自己否定はない。

段階1の責任順位・程度を維持する。この語義は第一次的責任者を二次的責任者と明示的に対比しており、保証人の定義も主債務者の不履行時に負う責任を示す。したがって当該保証関係内の第一次・第二次という順位の対立が成立する。違い行にこの対立の否定はない。
段階1の重要度・程度を維持する。principal の高い重要性と minor の小さい重要性は語義定義に共有された尺度の両側に位置する。違い行も程度対立を説明しており、軸転移や自己否定はない。

attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "one of the orchestra's principals"; "lists her as". The predicative professional role 'one of the orchestra’s principals' denotes a ranked performer. Sense 002 would denote governing authority over the organization, whereas this concert-program role attribution names membership in its set of principals.

discriminating_terms: treats a person who knowingly assists the offense as a principal
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "treats a person who knowingly assists the offense as a principal". Classification as principal is explicitly predicated on knowing assistance of an offense, giving the criminal responsibility relation of 006. Sense 005 requires someone authorizing an agent to act for them; the sentence instead classifies the assisting offender.
Lexical anchor: "a principal source of income". Principal attributively ranks the income source. Sense 004 would name invested capital itself, not modify the count noun source.

Lexical anchor: "The school principal". The lexical role construction school principal denotes the person heading the school. Sense 001 cannot supply the nominal head of this noun phrase, and sense 003 would require a performer role rather than this institutional head title.

discriminating_terms: protect the principal while generating modest returns
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "protect the principal while generating modest returns". Principal is the preserved capital contrasted with generated returns. Sense 007 denotes an obligor, not a capital stock maintained while it earns returns.
Lexical anchor: "The principal reason". Principal modifies and ranks reason. Sense 002 is a person-denoting noun and cannot provide this scalar modification of reason.

discriminating_terms: one of the principal architects of the reform
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "one of the principal architects of the reform". Principal modifies architects, ranking the reform's creators. Sense 002 would itself name a leader rather than function as the adjective modifying the plural head architects.

discriminating_terms: liable as principal for the debt
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "liable as principal for the debt"; "guarantor is only secondarily liable". Primary debt liability is expressly contrasted with the guarantor's secondary liability. Sense 005 concerns authorization of an agent, which does not explain this explicit ordering of liability.
Lexical anchor: "its principal place of business". Principal modifies place and identifies its central rank. Sense 004 would denote capital, not adjectivally rank a business location.

discriminating_terms: identified him as a principal in the crime
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "identified him as a principal in the crime". The complement in the crime identifies principal as a criminal-participation classification. Sense 005 would classify him relative to an authorized agent, not directly as a participant in the crime.

discriminating_terms: guarantee does not replace the obligation of the principal
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "guarantee does not replace the obligation of the principal". Principal is the holder of the underlying obligation retained alongside its guarantee. Sense 005 denotes the source of an agent's authority; that relation does not explain the guarantee's nonreplacement of this underlying obligation.

Lexical anchor: "The principal of the college". Principal of the college is an institutional head title. Sense 003 would require a leading performance role; principal here heads an of-phrase identifying the institution governed rather than a performing section.
Lexical anchor: "repaying principal". Principal is the uncountable amount repaid, selecting capital. Sense 007 is a countable debtor who owes repayment, not the monetary object of repaying.

Lexical anchor: "agent may sign"; "on behalf of the principal". The signing agent acts on behalf of principal, explicitly realizing the represented party relation. Sense 007 concerns first-order debt liability, absent from this signing-for-another construction.

Lexical anchor: "created a principal-agent relationship". The compound principal-agent relationship directly names the reciprocal authorization roles. Sense 002 denotes organizational leadership, not the counterparty role paired with agent in this established relation.

discriminating_terms: duties of the principal and the surety
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "duties of the principal and the surety". Principal and surety form the paired primary-obligor and guarantor roles whose duties are specified. Sense 005 would pair principal with an agent on an authorization axis, whereas the expressly paired counter-role here is surety.

discriminating_terms: the principal cause of the failure
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "the principal cause of the failure". Principal adjectivally ranks cause. Sense 006 denotes an offender, not an adjective modifying an abstract cause.

discriminating_terms: payment includes both principal and interest
attributions.rationale: Lexical anchor: "payment includes both principal and interest". Principal is a component of payment explicitly contrasted with interest. Sense 007 names a liable party and cannot constitute the amount included in a payment alongside interest.

Lexical anchor: "payments"; "pay down the principal". The pay down construction selects a reducible outstanding capital amount. Sense 007 names an obligor, who cannot be the amount reduced by paying down.

Lexical anchor: "A college principal". College principal is a compound institutional head title. Sense 001 would require a following nominal head and cannot itself head this count noun phrase; sense 003 names a performance role rather than the institutional head title present here.
